sloka: ततो न्यपातयत् क्रोधाच्छङ्खदेशे महत्तलम् ।। ६.९७.३० ।।दीप्तं पतङ्गा ज्वलनं यथा ।। ६.९७.२ ।।
transliteration: tato nyapātayat krodhācchaṅkhadeśe mahattalam ।। 6.97.30 ।।dīptaṁ pataṅgā jvalanaṁ yathā ।। 6.97.2 ।।

translations.english: The Vanara, seeing the blow given by Virupaksha, enraged Sugriva hit him with another palm on the temporal bone by which he fell.
